title: publish-packages config
description: Controls which pnpm workspace packages the publish-packages workflow is allowed to build and publish to GitHub Packages.

$schema.description: Pointer back to this schema file, for editor validation/autocomplete. Not read by any workflow.

include.description: Glob patterns (matched against the workspace-relative package directory, e.g. "packages/example-sdk") whose matching packages are eligible for publish. Supports '*' and '?' wildcards.

exclude.description: Glob patterns that override 'include'. Use for packages that are still in development and must never be published automatically, even if a path matches 'include'.
